scripts.format: biome check --write . && uv run ruff format python tests/python
scripts.lint: biome check . && uv run ruff check python tests/python && uv run ruff format --check python tests/python
scripts.test: bun test tests/unit && uv run pytest tests/python
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.test:integration: bun test tests/integration && uv run pytest -m integration tests/python
scripts.test:modeling:data: uv run --group data pytest tests/python/test_modeling_dataset_v3.py tests/python/test_modeling_prepare_ds.py tests/python/test_modeling_prepare_tab.py
scripts.test:modeling:system: uv run --project environments/tabarena --frozen --offline pytest -m upstream tests/python/test_tabarena_system.py
